notes.title: Mushroom Season - Update 1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 1[/b][/h1]

Hi there!

The update took a bit longer than I planned – sorry for the delay. The game now has a lot of new content, and I hope you’ll enjoy it! I don’t want to spoil everything in the changelog to keep some surprises. Let me know what you think!

[url=https://i.ibb.co/stGGCd5/screenshot1.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/qxffC30/screenshot1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New locations
[*] New vehicle
[*] New side quests
[*] New Steam achievements
[*] Basic controller support
[*] 5 new mushroom species
[*] New items (food, basket, etc.)
[*] Improvements to existing locations
[*] Option to switch to manual transmission
[*] Added keybinding customization
[*] Minor changes to Grandpa Marian’s house furniture
[*] Ability to switch between carried baskets
[*] Unfortunately [b]saves from the previous game version are not compatible with the current one[/b]. However, I’ve reworked the save structure to prevent this issue in future updates.
[*] The player character is now visible behind the wheel while driving
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Alternative option to choose dialogue (arrows)
[*] Fixed an issue with a car disappearing when the player went to sleep
[*] Fixed freezing dialogues
[*] Improved vehicle controls
[*] Adjustments to mushroom growth cycles
[*] Changes to game economy
[*] It is no longer possible to drop a basket by pressing "G" on an occupied slot, which often caused baskets to get lost
[*] Small mushrooms and items should no longer fall "under the map"
[*] Fixed a bug where the mechanic didn’t charge for repairing a specific car
[*] Improved fog rendering distance
[*] Chanterelle texture changed to a slightly more yellow hue
[*] Grass no longer clips into vehicle interiors
[*] Added a slider to adjust mushroom rendering distance
[*] Vehicle interior camera movement is now smoother
[*] Fixed tire screech sound occurring at high speeds
[*] The game should now run smoother
[*] Loading times have been slightly improved
[*] Improved wet surface effect after rain
[*] Cars should no longer fly into the air when running into them
[*] NPCs driving cars should no longer clip through the windshield
[*] "Mushroom-o-matic" should no longer swallow large buckets
[*] Fixed several minor translation errors
[*] Many other minor changes
[/list]
